Add Document

Every file inside the selected folder will be added as its own document.

Select the root folder containing a Wing > Flat > Subcategory structure (e.g. A WING / A0504 / Loan Details / file.pdf). Every file inside is mapped to its flat and subcategory automatically.

Use {wing}, {flat}, or {subcategory} as the placeholder for the part of the folder name that varies; the rest must match exactly (case-insensitive).
